## GRAPHICS

SPECIFICATIONS

• NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER GPU 
• 3072 CUDA cores 
• 8GB GDDR6 memory 
• 256-bit memory bus 
• Engine boost clock: 1845 MHz

• PCI Express 3.0

• 3 x DisplayPort 1.4 
• HDMI 2.0b 
• Quad simultaneous display capable 

SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY

• Game Ready Drivers 
• Microsoft DirectX 12 API, Vulkan API 
• OpenGL 4.5 
• Microsoft Windows 10/7 64-bit, Linux 64-bit

• Strong Factory OC 
• 16+4 Power Phase 
• PowerBoost
